nodes.label: Multi-Guild Migration Plan (MEE6-level)
nodes.rationale: Approved source of truth for migrating the Cheterin bot + dashboard from single-guild to multi-guild operation; implementation not started. Main guild ID 1324239354154975252.

nodes.label: Manage Server Access Model
nodes.rationale: Dashboard access per guild is granted by Discord Manage Server / Administrator permission (MEE6 model) instead of .env role lists; DASHBOARD_ACCESS_ROLE_IDS is removed. Server-side re-verification via resolve_guild_member because the OAuth guild list alone is not trusted.

nodes.label: Unified settings.db Per-Guild Storage
nodes.rationale: Single SQLite table module_settings(guild_id, module, json, updated_at) with WAL and busy_timeout replaces ~10 flat JSON configs and all load_config/save_config in *_core.py. mtime-cache pattern replaced by in-memory {(guild_id, module): data} cache invalidated on put. One-time startup migration writes existing flat configs under guild_id=1324239354154975252 and renames files to *.migrated.bak.

nodes.label: Two-Level Language Model
nodes.rationale: UI language is a personal user choice (header button, localStorage) while bot message language is a per-server setting stored in settings.db — two independent levels so a user's dashboard language never affects other members' bot messages.

nodes.label: MAIN_GUILD_ID Constant
nodes.rationale: MAIN_GUILD_ID = 1324239354154975252 (env, constant in access.py) is kept only for CTD, news relay, and super-admin checks after the mandatory GUILD_ID is removed from main.py.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Text Cleanup and Explicit Limits
nodes.rationale: Non-breaking first phase: remove 'imported from another bot' wording on dashboard pages, surface validation limits (sourced from routes/*.py) next to inputs, and delete superadmin/developers sections from public Docs.tsx.
nodes.norm_label: phase 1: text cleanup and explicit limits

nodes.label: Phase 2.2: Guild Dimension for Module Data
nodes.rationale: Adds guild_id to stats.db tables (xp_members PK becomes (guild_id, user_id), voice_sessions and audit_log get guild_id, existing rows assigned to guild 404) and moves all flat data JSON files (events, brackets, reaction_roles, giveaways, supply, voice_panel, serverlog, streams, etc.) into settings.db per-guild; xp_card_bg.png becomes card_bg/<guild_id>.png. DBs that already have guild_id (mafia/bunker/warns/private_rooms/family) get every query audited for guild filtering.
nodes.norm_label: phase 2.2: guild dimension for module data

nodes.label: Phase 2.3: OAuth Guilds Scope and Server Selection
nodes.rationale: OAuth scope becomes 'identify guilds' with tokens stored in the encrypted cookie session; callback no longer checks single-guild membership and redirects to /servers. New endpoints: GET /api/auth/guilds (filtered by MANAGE_GUILD|ADMINISTRATOR, has_bot flag, 60s cache for Discord rate limits), POST /api/auth/select-guild (server-side permission re-check, writes session active_guild_id), GET /api/auth/invite-url. ~25 route files switch from app[guild_id] to request[guild_id]. Risk: all dashboard users must re-login after the scope change.
nodes.norm_label: phase 2.3: oauth guilds scope and server selection

nodes.label: Phase 2.4: Bot Detached from GUILD_ID
nodes.rationale: main.py drops mandatory GUILD_ID, copy_global_to and clear_commands in favor of global tree.sync() (plus one-time cleanup of old guild commands; global commands take up to 1 hour to propagate). Every cog reads settings by the event's guild_id; schedulers (daily_topic, giveaways, tempban, supply, family birthdays) loop over all guilds with the module enabled via settings.db query or bot.guilds. on_guild_join sends a dashboard link; on_guild_remove marks settings inactive instead of deleting.

nodes.label: CTD Main-Guild Gate
nodes.rationale: CTD cog (memobb.py, CTD_ROLE_ID/CTD_CHANNEL_ID in config.json) becomes active only when guild.id == MAIN_GUILD_ID; its dashboard settings page is visible only with the main server selected, and CTD keys leave the shared config route.

nodes.label: News Relay as Super-Admin Feature
nodes.rationale: News relay (news.py + news_relay.json) moves from the shared menu into the super-admin section; it may listen to sources on any guild but validates that publish targets belong to the main guild only. news_relay.json migrates into settings.db under the main guild_id.

nodes.label: Super-Admin Check Against Main Guild
nodes.rationale: Super-admin remains the hardcoded role 1505359848433516734, but after migration the check is always resolved against MAIN_GUILD_ID regardless of the currently selected server.

nodes.label: Phase 3: RU/EN i18n Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Deliberately lightweight hand-rolled i18n: frontend dictionaries src/i18n/ru.ts and en.ts with useT() hook and LanguageProvider (no heavy libraries); backend i18n.py with t(key, lang, **fmt) and locales/ru.py, locales/en.py. Server language stored as settings.db (guild_id, 'language') with default ru; public game pages use the game server's language.

nodes.label: Slash Command Localization
nodes.rationale: Base command names switch to English (/bunker-game, /mafia-game, /giveaway) with Russian provided via name_localizations/description_localizations (discord.app_commands.locale_str). Renaming base names creates new commands for users, so it must be announced in advance.

nodes.label: Bilingual Bunker Game Cards
nodes.rationale: Every record in bunker_data.py gains name_en (and effect_en/description_en where present); character generation stores both languages in the card so display can follow the server language at render time.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Load and Resilience (MEE6 Level)
nodes.rationale: AutoShardedBot enabled early (Discord requires sharding ~2500 guilds), chunk_guilds_at_startup=False with minimal member_cache_flags and on-demand guild.chunk()/fetch; SQLite WAL + single-writer everywhere with a Postgres transition point at ~500+ active guilds (access layer designed so the swap is local); rate-limit queues for mass operations; bot verification and privileged-intent approval required at 75+ guilds; health metrics in super-admin panel.

nodes.label: XP Global-to-Main Migration Decision
nodes.rationale: XP is currently global (stats.db xp_members has PK user_id with no guild_id); during migration all existing XP is assigned to the main guild (agreed default) and other guilds start from zero. Every DB migration is preceded by an automatic *.bak-<date> backup and must be idempotent, following the bunker_db PRAGMA-migration pattern.
